name: a11y-content-checker
description: WordPress plugin that checks content accessibility while it is written.
author: Anderson Canale Garcia

scripts.dev:install: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml run --rm cli sh /scripts/install.sh
scripts.wp: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml run --rm cli wp
scripts.check: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml run --rm cli wp --url=http://localhost:8888/demo/ a11ycc check
scripts.i18n: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml run --rm -w /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/a11y-content-checker cli sh -c "wp i18n make-pot . languages/a11y-content-checker.pot --exclude=node_modules,vendor,dev && wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge"
